cases.query: Add a custom statusCode filter that must work in GetPaged, GetAll and GetDropdown for a Cogain service.
expected_behavior: Inspects BaseService and a nearby override before choosing a seam
Uses BeforeApplyAutoFilterCoreAsync for the shared paged and non-paged filter
Preserves BaseService orchestration
forbidden_behavior: Overrides GetPaged, GetAll, or GetDropdown to duplicate orchestration
Invents a hook without checking source

cases.query: Resolve snapshots for newly synchronized child rows during Update.
expected_behavior: Recognizes AfterMappingAsync runs before child synchronization
Uses AfterReconcileCollectionsAsync when synchronized children must already exist
Assesses remote-write consistency
forbidden_behavior: Assumes AfterMappingAsync can see incoming synchronized children

cases.query: Add OperationDetails collection synchronization to ProductionEstimate; payload rows may omit Id.
expected_behavior: Entity implements ISyncsChildren<ProductionEstimate>
Service overrides BuildIncomingGraph
Selects a stable natural key and separates mutable fields into onUpdate
Uses soft-delete without removing tracked required-FK children
forbidden_behavior: Makes the entity depend on DTO types
Removes missing rows from the navigation collection

cases.query: Customize Product Excel import with batch gRPC lookup and add two template columns.
expected_behavior: Keeps ImportFromExcel orchestration in BaseService
Uses import/template hooks after checking their current signatures
Batch-loads gRPC lookup data
Keeps parser, template, validation, and export columns consistent
forbidden_behavior: Calls gRPC once per row or cell

cases.query: After updating a Job, the detail refreshes but paged, all, and dropdown views remain stale.
expected_behavior: Finds the existing Job query-key family and its consumers
Invalidates the affected stable prefixes including parameter variants
Avoids a global cache clear
forbidden_behavior: Reloads the page to hide stale cache

cases.query: Edit hydration fails because API fromWarehouseId is null while the form schema expects a string.
expected_behavior: Maps API data to form-safe values during reset
Normalizes empty form values back to the nullable API contract on submit
Checks schema, form type, API type, reset, and submit mapping together
forbidden_behavior: Changes the backend contract only to satisfy a UI control

cases.query: A watched React Hook Form field is set inside useEffect and causes Maximum update depth exceeded.
expected_behavior: Makes the effect idempotent by comparing getValues before setValue
Hoists watched values instead of calling watch in dependency expressions
Adds regression coverage when practical
forbidden_behavior: Uses a changing key prop to force remounts as the primary fix

cases.query: Create a new frontend query for item-templates/production-order-source.
expected_behavior: Verifies the route exists in backend controllers or existing clients before implementation
Uses an existing endpoint/local derivation if the proposed route does not exist
forbidden_behavior: Implements a client call to an unverified endpoint
